I.A No. 5174 of 2025.
08/08.05.2025 Heard Mrs. J. Majumdar, learned counsel for the appellant and Mr. Rajneesh Vardhan, learned A.P.P.
This application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of this appeal.

The appellant has been convicted for the offences punishable under Sections 448, 342, 354B, 376(1)
IPC and has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 10 years along with a fine of Rs.
5,000/- for the offence under Section 376(1) IPC.
It has been alleged that the appellant had entered into the house of the victim and by addressing her as a witch, had committed rape upon her.
Submission has been advanced by the learned counsel for the appellant that the appellant is in custody since 18.08.2022.
It has further been submitted that the victim has not been examined as the I.O. has stated that she was not in a fit mental condition to adduce evidence.
Learned counsel submits that the son-in-law and daughter of the victim have been examined as P.W.6 and P.W.7, but none had seen the incident.
It has further been submitted that the appellant has been falsely implicated being an Ex-Sarpanch which would appear from the evidence of P.W.4.
Learned counsel adds that the medical report also is not suggestive of the fact that the victim was subjected to rape.
It has been stated that the victim was aged about 47 years.

sentences.text: Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the appellant.

On consideration of the fact that the victim has not been examined and the false implication of the appellant cannot be ruled out in view of the evidence of P.W.4, we are inclined to admit the appellant on bail.

Accordingly, during pendency of this appeal, the appellant is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-IV- cum-Special Judge (Crime against Women), Bokaro in S.T. No. 422/2022 arising out of Chandankiyari P.S. Case No. 152/2022.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-IV- cum-Special Judge (Crime against Women), Bokaro
